'''Grand Eucer Street''' was a street located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Eusebus]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Euceron]]. The street was home to the [[Sleek Cruiser Inn]], a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]].<ref name="Dangerous Game" />

*''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]'' {{1st}}
